# `to_timestamp_ltz`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Parses the `timestamp_str` expression with the `fmt` expression
to a timestamp with local time zone. Returns null with invalid input. By default, it follows casting rules to
a timestamp if the `fmt` is omitted.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
to_timestamp_ltz(timestamp_str[, fmt])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_timestamp_ltz, example 1
> SELECT to_timestamp_ltz('2016-12-31 00:12:00');
2016-12-31 00:12:00
```

```sql
-- to_timestamp_ltz, example 2
> SELECT to_timestamp_ltz('2016-12-31', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
2016-12-31 00:00:00
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
